sources.title: Tips for managing family lending and borrowing
sources.author: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau; modified 25 April 2024
sources.sections: Questions about the request, capacity, terms, duration and changes
sources.supported_use: Make a bounded offer and financial-help expectations explicit.
sources.limits: U.S. educational discussion, not a household contract. The dated gift-tax paragraph is not adopted; no current tax threshold or tax advice. Linked worksheet not inspected. All agreements are supplied fiction.

sources.title: Creating a cash flow budget
sources.author: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau; Your Money, Your Goals, November 2018
sources.sections: Four-page PDF text: beginning resources, inflows, outflows, carried balance and educational/privacy boundary
sources.supported_use: Explain timing and verify a public learning resource.
sources.limits: Public PDF retrieved without login or charge; text retrieval is not accessibility certification. No full toolkit, actual household figures or benefit rules adopted. Timing numbers and hardship calendar are original.

sources.title: Talking to your child about financial decisions
sources.author: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau; modified 26 June 2026
sources.sections: Opening developmental discussion and saving-goal/budgeting descriptions
sources.supported_use: Support age-appropriate money conversations and explaining choices.
sources.limits: Page descriptions only; linked activities and survey were not inspected or administered. The 60-unit rehearsal is original, not a validated assessment or a real child response.

sources.title: Sustainable Materials Management Tools
sources.author: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency; updated 16 June 2026
sources.sections: Why measurement is important and overview of lifecycle-oriented tools
sources.supported_use: Keep lifecycle effects visible while distinguishing measured and unknown impacts.
sources.limits: No tool run, lifecycle assessment or quantified carbon/water benefit. The six-stage map and bag-use events are original teaching materials.

sources.title: FRAKTA shopping bag, large, blue; article 206.111.08
sources.author: IKEA U.S.; manufacturer product page
sources.sections: Materials, care instructions and food-contact restriction
sources.supported_use: Apply the actual item-specific wipe-clean instruction and exclude food contact.
sources.limits: Manufacturer instructions for this article only; not a universal bag-care rule or purchase recommendation. Price, reviews, service life and upstream production conditions are not adopted. Actual bag ownership and use are fictional.

sources.title: Community Assistance Division
sources.author: Pima County, Arizona
sources.sections: Assistance scope, county service, phone/hours, eligibility/funding conditions and document categories
sources.supported_use: Provide one inspected official local route and a bounded inquiry plan.
sources.limits: No actual contact or application. Cost and response turnaround are not stated in the inspected page and remain unverified; eligibility, funds and support amount unknown. Pima County is the supplied case location, not the learner’s assumed location.

sources.title: What Are Benefits Cliffs?
sources.author: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta
sources.sections: Introductory explanation of earnings, assistance loss, cliffs and plateaus
sources.supported_use: Recognize that earnings and net available resources can move differently.
sources.limits: Conceptual explanation only; state example dollar values, videos, CLIFF tools and underlying eligibility data not used. No personal benefit calculation or recommendation to refuse work.

sources.title: Secretaries and Administrative Assistants
sources.author: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics; Occupational Outlook Handbook
sources.sections: Duties, work environment and preparation sections
sources.supported_use: Compare coordination duties, typical preparation and work patterns.
sources.limits: National occupational profile, not a live local vacancy, salary offer or personal earnings forecast. Wage and employment projections are not adopted; role comparability is limited and explicitly examined.

sources.title: Project Management Specialists
sources.author: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics; Occupational Outlook Handbook
sources.sections: Duties including budget/staff/schedule, work pattern and preparation
sources.supported_use: Identify broader responsibilities and a capability gap in a neighboring role.
sources.limits: National occupational profile, not a live local vacancy or promised pay. No equivalence to administrative work or individual qualification is inferred. Salary statistics and projected job growth are not used.

sources.title: Plan your business
sources.author: U.S. Small Business Administration
sources.sections: Market research and competitive analysis passages; break-even formula and cost categories
sources.supported_use: Frame demand/alternatives and compute fixed cost divided by positive unit contribution.
sources.limits: Consolidated destination of market-research, startup-cost and break-even redirects, counted once. No claim that break-even proves viability. The page’s erroneous quarterly-to-monthly divide-by-four example is not adopted; all case arithmetic is original and recomputed. No linked market datasets or actual demand evidence.

sources.title: Recordkeeping
sources.author: U.S. Internal Revenue Service
sources.sections: Reasons for records, supporting documents and variable retention needs
sources.supported_use: Keep income, expenses and transaction support inspectable.
sources.limits: General U.S. tax recordkeeping information, not a filing or compliance determination. No universal retention period is supplied; linked publications were not read. Tabletop 30-day disposal is a synthetic exercise choice only.

sources.title: Beginners’ Guide to Financial Statements
sources.author: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission; reviewed 5 February 2007
sources.sections: Income and cash-flow explanation and relationship between financial statements
sources.supported_use: Separate profit, available cash and unpaid receivables in a toy operation.
sources.limits: Historical educational guide, not current accounting policy, legal interpretation or a complete financial statement. Original simplified figures omit tax and other obligations; no real books or investor decision inspected.

sources.title: Protecting Personal Information: A Guide for Business
sources.author: U.S. Federal Trade Commission
sources.sections: Opening principles, data inventory and limiting unnecessary information/access
sources.supported_use: Minimize data and make authorized access purposeful.
sources.limits: Selected general guidance, not a security audit or proof of lawful privacy practice. No real personal information, system configuration or linked statutory determination inspected.

sources.title: Monopolization Defined
sources.author: U.S. Federal Trade Commission
sources.sections: Market definition, power, exclusionary conduct and legitimate business justification
sources.supported_use: Distinguish successful competition from concerns requiring evidence of conduct and effects.
sources.limits: U.S. explanatory guidance, not a legal finding. Numerical share thresholds and historical litigation examples are not imported; no actual firm or relevant market is investigated.

sources.title: Standard Setting in a Network Economy
sources.author: David A. Balto, FTC staff speech; 17 February 2000
sources.sections: Opening disclaimer and network value, switching/lock-in and interoperability discussion
sources.supported_use: Explain network advantage and possible benefits and burdens of compatibility.
sources.limits: Historical speaker views, explicitly not necessarily Commission views or current policy. Later legal case analysis and cited research were not adopted. Booking examples and export test are original fiction.

sources.title: Using in-depth interviews
sources.author: GOV.UK Service Manual, User research community; 21 February 2017
sources.sections: Interview planning, consent, open neutral questions and recent concrete examples
sources.supported_use: Make discovery conversations informative without pitching the answer.
sources.limits: Selected method guidance only; linked consent/recruiting resources and case studies not inspected. No actual recruitment, recording, interview or representative sample.
